svg.title: The flywheel: a trace becomes a test becomes a fix
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “The flywheel: a trace becomes a test becomes a fix” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A hand-drawn, deliberately lopsided circle of five boxes with clockwise arrows: a production trace, an online score from a judge and user thumbs taken automatically in about 600 milliseconds, a labelled eval case created in four minutes where nine days is struck out, a versioned prompt v8 gated by the eval suite, and a deployment whose traces are tagged with the prompt version, closing back to production and verified there rather than only in CI. In the centre a small growth chart shows the eval suite going from 120 to 167 cases and the online score from 78 to 88 percent over eight weeks; below, a straight 'failure, fix, hope' arrow is struck through as no verification means no learning.
svg.text: The flywheel: a trace becomes a test becomes a fix
draw it from memory, then compare
